AMD FidelityFX SDK 1.1.4 (MIT): frame interpolation and optical flow, with changes that let one
pair of frames yield several generated frames, and the recipe that builds it for Linux
(ffx_fg/, GPL-3.0-or-later). Taken on 2026-11-13 from the Lichii project at commit 8618ffe51f.

  ffx/include/   the SDK's headers, as the layer is built against
  ffx_src/       the SDK's sources and the build recipe (./build.sh -> build/ffx/ffx_fg/libffx_fg.a)
  lichii/        Vulkan test helpers and the compatibility header the layer is built with
                 (GPL-3.0-or-later)

Adwaita Sans (SIL Open Font License 1.1): the letters of the layer's panel are a rendering of it
(fg/hud_font.h, made by tools/make-hud-font.py from Fedora's adwaita-sans-fonts 50.0, font version 4.001).

  adwaita-sans/LICENSE   the font's copyright notices and the licence text, as its package carries them
